$comment: Example content for a portal named Example Corp Developers. Run apply_content.py --export first: pages are matched by path, products, plans and catalogues by their Name on your Portal. Every Home block of the default theme is listed, so no stock copy survives.

blocks.HeaderDescription: Orders, payments and reference data from Example Corp, ready for your product. Create an app, pick a plan and make your first call in minutes.
blocks.UseCasesDescription: Three common ways teams use Example Corp APIs.
blocks.UseCase1Description: Show order status and account data inside your own web and mobile apps.
blocks.UseCase2Description: Keep your ERP and billing systems in step with Example Corp, without manual exports.
blocks.UseCase3Description: Pull reference data into your warehouse for reporting and planning.
blocks.FlipFlopRightImageSubTitle1: Six steps, most of them one click.
blocks.FlipFlopRightImageDescription1:
1. Create an account
  2. Browse the catalogue
  3. Add an API to your cart
  4. Request access
  5. Wait for approval
  6. Use your credentials
blocks.FlipFlopRightImageInnerDescription1: Sign up with your work email. You can invite colleagues to your organisation later.
blocks.FlipFlopRightImageInnerDescription2: Each API has a description, a reference you can try, and the plans it is offered on.
blocks.FlipFlopRightImageInnerTitle3: Add an API to your cart
blocks.FlipFlopRightImageInnerDescription3: Pick the plan that fits. APIs that share an authentication method can be requested together.
blocks.FlipFlopRightImageInnerDescription4: Choose an existing app or create one, then submit the request.
blocks.FlipFlopRightImageInnerDescription5: Some plans are approved at once. For the others we email you when a decision is made.
blocks.FlipFlopRightImageInnerDescription6: Your keys are under My apps. Rotate or revoke them there at any time.
blocks.FlipFlopLeftImageDescription1: Example Corp runs order and payment services for retailers in twelve countries. These APIs are the same ones our own products use.
blocks.FeaturedProductsDescription: The APIs most teams start with.

blocks.HeaderDescription: Example Corp runs order and payment services for retailers in twelve countries.
blocks.NoImageSectionDescription: Our customers asked to connect their own systems to ours. The APIs on this portal are the answer: documented, versioned and supported.
blocks.FlipFlopRightImageDescription: Every API has an owner. Questions go to developers@example.com and are answered within one working day.
blocks.FlipFlopLeftImageDescription: We announce breaking changes six months ahead and keep the previous version running until the date we gave.

blocks.HeaderDescription: The terms that apply when you use Example Corp APIs.
blocks.NoImageSectionDescription: Use the APIs for your own products, keep your credentials private and stay within your plan's limits. The full text is available from developers@example.com.
